priority: edit existing asset and preserve unchanged fields

questions.guided8: one question per turn; skip already supplied and irrelevant steps

doubao.onboarding: paste doubao/AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md; attach files only if supported
doubao.image: use actual available image tool; do not assume external shell or HTML can run in chat
doubao.editing: image edit if available; for precise text use offline HTML editor

workbuddy.onboarding: import folder including SKILL.md, references, tools
workbuddy.image: check host image tools and permissions before invoking; no compulsory API setup
workbuddy.editing: host image edit if supported; offline editor for exact text

offline_compiler.optional: Python standard library local script tools/compile_brief.py, no third-party dependencies

failure_policy.no_image_tool: return compiled prompt and say image not generated
failure_policy.text_accuracy: no-text generated background plus editable text layers
failure_policy.unsupported_resolution: report actual output and do not claim target resolution
failure_policy.image_edit_failure: preserve original; explain failure and provide fallback
failure_policy.reference_missing: do not claim reference was seen

api_secret_policy: Never request users paste API keys into chat or project JSON. No external API required for default flow.
